question: Should new Codex work keep using the cheaper model, and should the daily check stop?
big_picture: This setting sends new Codex work to GPT-6 Luna so your weekly usage quota lasts longer; four kinds of work keep their usual models. You have kept it on every time you answered the repeated daily question, so I recommend making it standing and asking again only if usage or quality changes. Keeping the daily check means the question returns tomorrow; turning the setting off sends new work to stronger models that use quota faster. With no answer, the setting stays on and the daily question returns tomorrow.
reason: You have chosen to keep it on every time you answered, so a standing setting saves daily attention while preserving your quota benefit.
